title: Shape tween (morph) visual oracle E2E — verify DefineMorphShape2 mid-frame rendering in Ruffle
description: Implemented shape-morph.spec.ts with 4 E2E tests: (1) SWF structure check for tag 84, (2) frame 0 non-blank (10000 non-white pixels), (3) mid-frame rendering differs from start frame (12288 pixel diff, 11088 vs 10000 non-white), (4) end frame non-blank after full play cycle (11400 non-white pixels). Also fixed a critical bug in morphshape.ts: writeMorphStyleChangeRecord was writing 7 bits (1 isEdge + 1 extra + 5 flags) instead of the correct 6 bits (1 isEdge + 5 flags), causing all flag bits to be offset by one position - Ruffle misread the entire start shape. The fix removes the extra bit. Combined with the 0x00 nibble fix and isEndShape=true, Ruffle now correctly renders the morph shape at all ratios. All 4 tests pass.
